content:
The phrase **"And now, the rest of the story"** is famously associated with **Paul Harvey**, an American radio broadcaster.

Paul Harvey used this signature sign-off on his long-running radio program **"The Rest of the Story,"** which aired on ABC Radio Networks. The show featured stories about interesting or little-known facts behind famous people or events, always ending with a surprising reveal followed by his iconic closing line.

Paul Harvey was one of the most listened-to radio personalities in American history, and his program ran for decades until his death in **2009**.
